items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 28 July 2026 10:34pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 28 July 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure centred to the north of Scotland.


##Wind##

Mainly southwest 5 or 6 at first, decreasing 3 or 4 overnight. Then veering north or northwest late tomorrow afternoon, before settling west by tomorrow night.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, decreasing slight overnight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then patchy rain progressing eastwards late tomorrow afternoon.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5 for a time later on Thursday morning and early afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight.


##Weather##

Patchy rain clearing to the east, then mostly fair.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in rain at first.
